form_value.value: none: each experiment recruited its own participants, and no other paper's sample is analyzed

problems.source_says: The saved document describes recruitment for each experiment but never establishes that their participants are disjoint or that none also appear in another paper. In particular, separate Prolific recruitment for S1 and S3 and separate MTurk recruitment for S2 and S4 do not rule out repeat participants. The quoted passage describes S3 recruitment and reuse of screening criteria, not absence of participant overlap. The primary sample_overlap fields are blank, but this reconciliation entry incorrectly treats no overlap as confirmed; overlap remains unknown.
problems.quote: 803 participants recruited from Prolific Academic (Mage= 42.38, 40.3% female, 58.8% male) completed the experiment and passed all pre-registered screenings (as used in Experiment 1).
problems.locator: PDF p. 13, Materials and Methods, Experiment 3; recruitment descriptions on pp. 12-13; full saved document pp. 1-17 contains no explicit sample-overlap statement.

problems.field: open_questions[3]; source.supplement.holds (Table S2); eligibility.reason; studies[].participants.exclusions (claims about per-arm counts in the SI)
problems.form_value: Randomized counts and per-arm counts are only in SI Table S2, which is not in this PDF.
problems.source_says: The PDF says Table S2 summarizes numbers preregistered, dropout rates, and final sample sizes across experiments. It does not establish that the table contains actual randomized counts or counts for each arm; preregistered targets are not randomized totals. The SI Appendix is neither included nor embedded in the 17-page PDF, and no matching local supplement was found. Requests to the cited OSF project, its API, and the alternate SSRN source failed with WinError 10013 (network access blocked), so the claimed table contents could not be checked. The null randomized and individual-arm counts are appropriate, but claims that the unavailable table definitely supplies them are unsupported.
problems.quote: Please see SI Appendix, Table S2 for a summary of number of participants preregistered, dropout rates, and final sample sizes obtained across experiments.
problems.locator: PDF p. 12, opening Materials and Methods paragraph referring to SI Appendix Table S2; p. 5 refers to Table S4 for excluded no-LLM participants. SI Appendix unavailable.

confirmed.statement: S1 analyzed 396 people who completed the experiment and passed all preregistered screenings; individuals were randomized to LLM or no-LLM. The reported t(394) is consistent with that total.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Materials and Methods, Experiment 1; p. 5, Results, Experiment 1.

confirmed.statement: S2 analyzed 213 people who completed the experiment and passed all preregistered screenings; individuals were randomized to LLM or no-LLM. The accuracy analysis reports t(211), consistent with 213.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 13, Materials and Methods, Experiment 2; pp. 5-6, Results, Experiment 2.

confirmed.statement: S3 analyzed 803 people across four randomized LLM-by-incentive conditions. The ANOVA denominator df of 799 agrees with 803 people in four cells.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 13, Materials and Methods, Experiment 3; p. 6, Results, Experiment 3.

confirmed.statement: S4 analyzed 400 people across four randomized combinations of LLM availability in two stages. The stages involve the same participants, who could skip Stage 2, and are not separate samples; t(398) is consistent with 400.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 13, Materials and Methods, Experiment 4; p. 7, Results, Experiment 4; p. 14, Fig. 8.

confirmed.statement: Each of S1-S4 independently exceeds 50 analyzed people. These Ns count participants, while the generated hypotheses are sports-team names and are separate outcome units.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 12-13, participant descriptions; p. 5, number of unique teams as the hypothesis-count outcome; pp. 11-13, random assignment.

confirmed.statement: The exclusion rules require correct knowledge answers, at least one listed team, and no LLM use unless assigned. No-LLM participants reporting LLM use were excluded after the task, with a robustness analysis restoring them; exact exclusion and dropout counts cannot be recovered from the saved PDF.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Experiment 1 inclusion criteria; p. 13, inherited screenings in Experiments 2-4; p. 5, Paradigm; p. 9, Generalization without exclusions.

confirmed.statement: Exact randomized totals and the two-arm or four-cell analyzed counts are not printed in the saved PDF, so the corresponding null fields should remain null. Figures 6-8 show procedures without participant-flow counts; the stated target of 100-200 per condition is not an observed sample size.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 12-14, Materials and Methods and Figs. 6-8; complete saved PDF pp. 1-17.

confirmed.statement: S3 reports 395 participants in the combined LLM conditions, of whom 385 pasted valid raw LLM outputs after the key dependent measures. The 385-person subset concerns the raw-output analysis and does not replace the main S3 N of 803 or supply the four separate cell counts.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 10, LLM output quality and hypothesis generation; p. 6 and p. 13, S3 total and factorial design.

confirmed.statement: The four main analyzed totals sum to 1,812, whereas the abstract prints 1,814. The form already flags this unexplained source discrepancy; it does not negate the explicit study-specific counts.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 2, Abstract; pp. 12-13, Materials and Methods; form open_questions[2].

confirmed.statement: S5 is described as an ancillary occupation-guessing experiment, but its participant count, arm counts, and exclusions are not supplied in the saved PDF; its null Ns are warranted.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 11, Discussion, reference to SI Appendix Section 5.

confirmed.statement: The complete 41,229-character markdown conversion, including references and final figure legends, was read. The 17-page PDF has no appended or embedded SI; the relevant PDF participant passages and procedure figures were checked directly.
confirmed.locator: Markdown conversion from beginning through final Fig. 8 legend; PDF pp. 1-17, especially pp. 12-14 and p. 17.

summary: The four main randomized studies explicitly report 396, 213, 803, and 400 analyzed people, so criterion 2 holds. The coding nevertheless contains unsupported claims that the samples do not overlap and that the unavailable appendix supplies randomized and per-arm counts.
